title: Aawdi Hare
intro: Ko adii nde aduna oo anndata hare yaajnde, jarribo luggiɗngo e goonɗinal e ɗooftaare waɗii. Ndee ɗoo tinndinoore ina yuurnitoo suɓngooji ɗi neɗɗo waɗata, ɗi golle mum mbaɗata ko ina addana yontaaji garooji. Heɓtu ngam udditde daartol ruuhu gonɗo e haɓde e kaaɗdi mawndi e batte mum bonɗe.
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e ɓiɓɓe adanɓe yahde e leydi, ɓiɗɗo aadee gadano oo.
Miin e miñi am, min njamiraama yo min mbaɗan Alla sadak, jarribo ngoon laaɓal amen.
Sadaka am ja6aaka, tawi ko miñi am ja6aaka, cfum he6tinii 6ernde am 6uu6ol kul6iniingol.
Mi haali konnguɗi kulɓiniiɗi e miñi am, ɗi mettere jaɓde riiwti.
Miñi am jaabiima e hakkille e dewal, ina siftina kam peewal Alla e kulol mum.
Ko fayti e konngol miñi am ngol newaare e yarlitaare mum e yaafnaade, mi ƴettii nguurndam, mi wonti gooto e majjuɓe.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
